item.title: TIL: Apple Broke Time Machine Again on Tahoe
item.description:
📝 2-86009-1 My Backup Backup PlanSince I’m tired of Apple breaking Time Machine every few years and the lack of transparency around this (it’s not Synology’s fault), I have decided to implement a more robust solution that doesn’t depend on Synology’s SMB implementation. I already have a Proxmox server with ZFS as the backend storage that has an LXC container running Samba for general file sharing, so I decided to look into that as a possible Time Machine target. But if anyone from Apple is reading this: please, stop breaking Time Machine every few years.
🔗 Read more: https://taoofmac.com/space/til/2026/02/01/1630

item.title: Clearspace (YC W23) Is Hiring an Applied Researcher (ML)
item.description:
📝 People that want a better relationship with their devices have nowhere to turn except for willpower. We are building an agent that achieves this on all devices by processing and filtering network traffic based on natural language rules. You don’t just think about the model but “how can we get more data volume”; “how can we featurize the data intelligently”; “what are our data needs based on our task and desired model size”, and like building backwards from inference requirements.
🔗 Read more: https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/clearspace/jobs/GOWiDwp-research-engineer-at-clearspace
